in_sanskrit.name: Manglesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon-given, Earth-born
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manglesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Manglesh is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Mangal’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning lord. The name Manglesh is thus a compound of these two words and means ‘Moon-given’ or ‘Moon-bestowed’. The second part of the name, ‘Lesh’, comes from the Sanskrit root ‘Las’ meaning to nourish or to bring up. Thus, the name Manglesh can be interpreted to mean ‘Moon-given, Earth-born’ or ‘Moon-nourished, Earth-born’. This name is often given to a child born during a lunar eclipse or during a full moon night.
